name: grid
pattern: Two-dimensional keyboard interaction for native tables following the APG Grid Pattern
responsibility: Adds a grid role and two-dimensional roving tabindex to consumer-authored native tables. No custom events or state outputs. Table-sort handles sorting. Does not change or generate row order, appearance, or content.

authorMarkup.label: The consumer names the table through caption, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
authorMarkup.rows: The consumer writes thead/tbody structure, tr, th, and td elements.
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate elements or content.

semanticElements: The root must be an HTMLTableElement.
At least one row and one cell are required.
The root must have an accessible name.
Cells must not have rowspan or colspan.
Every row must have the same number of cells.
pageSize must be an integer of at least one.
contractValidation.spanRationale: Merged cells make row/column correspondence nonrectangular and the definition of adjacent cells implementation-dependent; APG does not define merged-cell navigation. Restricting grids to rectangles makes navigation expressible by row and column indexes.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Validate markup on connection. Invalid markup prevents role writes, listeners, and tabindex operations and warns once per connection. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: Warnings identify grid controller, the required native table root, and violated conditions.

completion.warning: The completion warning lists the added attributes: "Added <attributes>. Include them in your markup." It is emitted once while connected, using a separate flag from the enhancement-disabled warning

pageSize.description: Rows moved by PageUp/PageDown. APG leaves this distance to authors, so accept a value. Stop at the boundary when fewer rows remain.

focusCell(row, column).description: Move focus to the specified row and column without custom events.

events.none: Grid emits no custom events. DOM focus represents cell navigation and can be observed through focusin. Table-sort owns sort-request events.

consumerIntegration.programmatic: Other controllers may use activeCell and focusCell() through a Stimulus controller reference or outlets.
consumerIntegration.sorting: Use table-sort on the same table when sorting is needed. The controllers are independent and do not reference each other.

behavior.scope: Always operate on rows/cells currently in the DOM. Rebuild roving tabindex when Turbo rendering or consumer sorting changes rows. Ctrl+End refers to the last DOM cell, not the end of unloaded data. Continuously growing grids such as infinite scrolling are outside the guarantee because users can observe that distinction.
behavior.focusModel: Use roving tabindex with DOM focus on cells. Do not redirect focus to focusable descendants. APG permits focusing a sole widget within a cell, but detecting a single widget and whether it consumes arrows is implementation-dependent. Consistently focusing cells keeps one navigation model; Tab enters widgets inside cells.
behavior.editing: Do not own cell edit mode or value commitment. Consumers can compose editable with a controller that starts editing and restores cell focus afterward, so grid does not duplicate draft/validation/commit state. Descendant keydown also reaches grid navigation; consumers must stop editing keys from propagating. See docs/plans/decision-grid-editing.md for composition and verification scope.
behavior.keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move within a row; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move within a column. Stop at boundaries without wrapping. Home/End go to the first/last cell in the row; Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End go to the first/last grid cell. PageUp/PageDown move pageSize rows and stop at boundaries.

managedMarkup.cells: Leave tr/th/td roles to the user agent's native mapping; do not write them.
managedMarkup.tabindex: Synchronize cell tabindex through roving; exactly one cell participates in the tab sequence.
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored id, role, and other attributes. The controller synchronizes the tabindex values needed for roving focus.

stateOutputs.ownership: No state outputs. DOM focus identifies the current cell and CSS can use :focus-visible. Do not output data-state on roots or items.

lifecycle: Register root keydown/focusin in connect(); remove them in disconnect().
Observe row/cell changes with MutationObserver and disconnect it during cleanup. Do not observe controller-written attributes.
Leave generated role and tabindex on disconnect().
Resynchronize role and roving tabindex with current markup on reconnection.
Do not duplicate listeners or observers when reconnecting the same instance.

observations.environment: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and screen readers on real devices
observations.item: Native cell/header mapping beneath table role=grid
observations.impact: The contract fixes role=grid on the table and retains native cell markup. It does not choose td/th role overrides from these observations.

acceptanceCriteria: The behavior and accessibility implemented by this component must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
The root has role="grid" and an accessible name; the controller does not write tr/th/td roles.
Two-dimensional arrows, Home, End, Ctrl+Home, Ctrl+End, PageUp, and PageDown match the APG Grid Pattern.
Exactly one cell participates in the tab sequence.
The controller emits no custom events.
The controller does not change DOM structure beneath the root.
Invalid markup disables enhancement with one warning
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Report agreement of native mapping for <table role="grid"> across the three engines and AT as unverified.

Conditions under which ARIA in HTML permits td/th role overrides have not been verified against primary specifications. The controller does not write those roles, so this does not affect current behavior. Verify before changing that design.

testMatrix.description: Role, roving tabindex, no cell roles added, and authored-attribute preservation
Two-dimensional arrows, boundary stops, and RTL reversal
Home/End, Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End, pageSize-based PageUp/PageDown, and boundary stops
Exactly one cell in the tab sequence
No custom events from focusCell(), trusted cell navigation, initialization, or reconnection
Listener and observer cleanup on disconnect/reconnect
Warnings and disabled enhancement for non-table roots, missing rows/cells, rowspan/colspan, unequal row lengths, or invalid pageSize

testMatrix: Engine-specific results for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
Screen-reader results on a real device (unverified)

testMatrix.description: Completion warnings for missing attributes, none for complete markup, and separation from invalid-markup warnings
